subject: Request to keep demo active while vendor paperwork (COI/PO) is processed
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira@healthpointlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request to keep demo active while vendor paperwork (COI/PO) is processed

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick ask on our end: procurement at HealthPoint just looped in legal and risk requesting an updated Certificate of Insurance plus a W-9 for vendor onboarding. They indicated the review could take 3–7 business days.

We want to make sure your engineering team can continue validating the integration without the trial window closing. Would it work for us to put the evaluation into a short-term "stasis" (no auto-expiry) or apply a temporary demo credit while finance completes the paperwork?

What we can do today if you confirm:
- Place the account in a 7-calendar-day stasis so the timer is paused,
- Deposit 5,000 test credits to cover integration runs (these are limited to dev/test endpoints), and
- Temporarily increase the session TTL for the sandbox so your SREs can keep long-running jobs active.

If procurement needs any specific language in our COI, please forward the request and I’ll get our contracts team to push back an updated PDF. I’ve attached our standard COI template and the pilot terms for reference.

Next steps: if you reply "go ahead" I’ll coordinate with Ben to deploy the stasis and credits and ping Marissa for any billing notes.

Best,
David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0123
Attachments: COI_HealthPoint_v3.pdf, Pilot-Terms-HP.docx
From: Samira Patel <samira@healthpointlabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@healthpointlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to keep demo active while vendor paperwork (COI/PO) is processed

David —

Appreciate the proactive offer. Procurement confirmed they need:
- Updated COI naming HealthPoint Labs as the insured (certificate holder details attached in their last ticket),
- W-9 from Redwood, and
- A short schedule describing expected monthly spend (they asked for a ballpark so they can map budget lines).

We expect the procurement queue to clear in about 4–6 business days unless legal requests changes to the contract language. I can confirm the exact certificate holder address later today.

A short-term stasis plus credits would be ideal. Please do the minimum required to keep the environment and integrations from resetting. Also — is there a way to limit the credits to non-production endpoints so we don’t accidentally run against our prod systems?

Thanks — I’ll reply with the COI details in a separate email.

Samira Patel
Director, Platform Integrations | HealthPoint Labs
samira@healthpointlabs.com
Phone: (617) 555-4490
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira@healthpointlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to keep demo active while vendor paperwork (COI/PO) is processed

Samira —

Thanks for the fast reply. Confirming we will:
1) Put HealthPoint Labs' evaluation account into "stasis" effective now; the trial countdown is paused for 7 calendar days.
2) Credit the account with 5,000 dev-only credits that are restricted to sandbox/dev endpoints (we’ll enforce endpoint tags).
3) Have Ben remove session TTL limits in the sandbox pool so long-running tests won’t be terminated.

Ben — can you enable the stasis and credit bundle on deal HP-1129 and add a note on the HubSpot record (link below)? Please confirm once complete so Samira can continue testing.

Samira — once procurement sends the COI and the W-9, we’ll ask finance to lift the stasis and convert credits (if any used) to a standard pilot arrangement per Pilot-Terms-HP.docx. If you need us to add any additional insured language, tag me and I’ll get the contracts team on it.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/pilot-HP-1129

Best,
David
